abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To develop a pathology-based preoperative decision-support system (Structured Imaging Report System for Pancreatic Cystic Lesions, SIRS-PCL) for subtype classification and risk stratification of PCLs.
METHODS: We conducted a multicentre retrospective study involving 1,102 patients treated between 1 January 2011 and 31 December 2024. The study cohort was divided into a development dataset (n = 858) and a temporal validation dataset (n = 244) from the periods 2011-2022 and 2023-2024, respectively. Three logistic prediction models were used to classify the five PCL subtypes and to perform separate three-tier risk stratifications (benign/low, medium, and high) for intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) and mucinous cystic neoplasm (MCN) cases. SIRS-PCL was prospectively implemented at Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute and Hospital from 25 June 2025 to 25 June 2026, and the diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity were evaluated in a cohort of 76 patients.
RESULTS: A total of 1,102 patients with PCLs were included in the study (median age 56 years, interquartile range 44-64), of whom 714 were female (64.8%). The five-category model included in SIRS-PCL achieved a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.93 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.91-0.95] in temporal validation. The IPMN model showed good discrimination for risk stratification (mean AUC 0.86, 95% CI 0.79-0.93), with the highest overall accuracy of 77.1% exceeding current guidelines (range 50.0%-58.6%). The MCN risk model also showed high performance (mean AUC 0.97, 95% CI 0.91-1.00). In comparison to current practice, SIRS-PCL use reduced unnecessary surgeries 11.5% vs. 23.1% and over-examinations 6.7% vs 33.7%. In the prospective implementation cohort, SIRS-PCL achieved accuracy of 86.2% for five-category pathological classification, 73.7% for IPMN risk stratification, and 100% for MCN risk stratification.
CONCLUSIONS: SIRS-PCL is a pathology-based, quantitative decision-support system for preoperative pathological subtype classification and pathological risk stratification of surgically evaluated neoplastic PCLs.

summary_ko: 연구진은 췌장 낭성 병변(PCL)의 하위 유형 분류와 위험도 층화를 위한 수술 전 의사결정 지원 시스템(SIRS-PCL)을 개발했습니다. 총 1,102명의 환자 데이터를 활용한 후향적 연구와 76명의 전향적 검증 코호트를 통해 진단 정확도를 평가했습니다. 개발된 시스템은 시간적 검증에서 5가지 범주 모델의 평균 수신자 작동 특성 곡선 아래 면적(AUC) 0.93을 기록했습니다. 또한, IPMN 및 MCN 위험도 모델에서 우수한 성능을 보였으며 기존 지침 대비 불필요한 수술과 과도한 검사를 줄였습니다.
title: An integrated CT/MRI diagnostic system for pancreatic cystic lesions that supports pathological classification and risk stratification
